3. Change the counted values for two non-first rows. Then Click Reset counts and reread every row. — expect: Every counted value must equal its System value and every Variance must display —.

verifications.evidence: Across the requested Washer stepper sequence, Washer remained 60 with an em-dash variance, while Hex bolt M4 changed instead (steps 4-7, including the post-action observation at step 7 of Washer 60/em dash and Hex 139/-1).

verifications.claim: Washer 11mm’s inline minus and plus steppers operate the Washer row accurately.
verifications.evidence: Direct attempts on the Washer minus and plus controls left Washer at 60/em dash but changed Hex bolt quantities and opened the Audit submitted dialog (steps 9-11 and 15-17).

verifications.claim: Reset counts restores altered audit counts to their system quantities and clears variances.
